Glastonbury Festival Ticket Prices Spark Fan Outrage

Fans of the Glastonbury Festival have expressed anger and frustration over the historically high ticket prices for the 2027 event. Reports indicate that ticket prices have surpassed £400, leading some attendees to label the cost as a 'scam'. The surge in pricing has caused significant discontent among festival-goers.
